'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**The [[Somali Armed Forces|military of Somalia]] carries out a series of [[counterterrorism]] [[military operation|operations]] in southern [[Somalia]], killing 15 [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] members who survived a previous operation two days ago, in which 49 fighters were killed. The military also says that they stopped an attack in Qayib, [[Galmudug]], killing dozens of militants. [https://english.news.cn/20221125/364950062f224438bf22599a28bb06e4/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[2022 São Tomé and Príncipe coup d'état attempt]]
**[[List of prime ministers of São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe prime minister]] [[Patrice Trovoada]] reports that his officials had thwarted a [[coup d'état]] attempt led by the President of the [[National Assembly (São Tomé and Príncipe)|National Assembly]], [[Delfim Neves]], after they arrested Neves and another individual for infiltrating the headquarters of the [[Armed Forces of São Tomé and Príncipe|armed forces]] in [[São Tomé]]. Four people were killed in the attempt. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/prime-minister-coup-thwarted-in-sao-tome-and-principe/2022/11/25/f7fda3b2-6d16-11ed-8619-0b92f0565592_story.html (AP via ''The Washington Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Ürümqi fire]]
**Ten people are killed and nine others injured in a fire at an apartment block in [[Ürümqi]], [[Xinjiang]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-fires-6a1b6902e6ccf87e064f1232045a2848 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*At the 19th [[CITES]] Conference of the Parties in [[Panama City]], member states adopt stricter measures on the trade of 54 [[Requiem shark|requiem]] and [[hammerhead shark]] species. [https://www.voanews.com/a/global-wildlife-summit-approves-shark-protections-/6850612.html (AFP via Voice of America)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aracruz school shootings]]
**Four people are killed and 12 others injured in a [[mass shooting]] targeting two schools in [[Aracruz, Espírito Santo|Aracruz]], [[Espírito Santo]], [[Brazil]]. The suspect, a 16-year-old boy, is later arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/shootings-education-caribbean-brazil-9829399a1b55a1c4f54b00bcd35d80c1 (AP)]
*[[Mount Isa Murders]]
**An [[Indian Australians|Indian Australian]] citizen, Rajwinder Singh, is arrested in [[New Delhi]] as the [[prime suspect]] in the murder of [[Australia]]n woman Toyah Cordingley on a beach in [[Far North Queensland]] in October 2018. [https://apnews.com/article/india-sydney-arrests-australia-queensland-786b300cd42e73b726f8ebcfb28545da (AP)]
